title: four-bilattice
description: The smallest non-trivial bilattice FOUR, the bilattice generated over the carrier {t, f, bot, top} with its truth and knowledge orders; isomorphic to the twist of the Boolean lattice 2 with itself.

carrier.description: the four values: t (told true), f (told false), bot (told nothing), top (told both)

truthOrder.description: generated by f <=t bot <=t t and f <=t top <=t t

knowledgeOrder.description: generated by bot <=k f <=k top and bot <=k t <=k top

negation.description: the negation ~ fixes bot and top and swaps t and f

twistProduct.description: FOUR is isomorphic to 2^bowtie, the twist of the Boolean lattice 2: f=<0,1>, bot=<0,0>, top=<1,1>, t=<1,0>
